records.summary: Appended 12 sources, one run update and five limitations in three immutable shards. Confirmed SBI Holdings completed its 100% Bitbank acquisition on Oct 1; Bitbank lists XRP/JPY, while SBI VC Trade has separate XRP/JPY spot/leverage and multiple retail XRP reward routes (Visa Crypto Card, Orico points, historical SBI Shinsei deposit campaign). Ripple's JFSA-approved RLUSD launched in Japan through SBI VC Trade; SBI VC Trade ranked RLUSD first in September custody-balance growth, JPYSC second and TON third, a relative ranking only. SBI Ripple Asia's tokenized-deposit XRPL work is a conceptual PoC, not production. Japan's 2026 FIEA/PSA amendment creates disclosure, insider-trading, tipping, market-manipulation, stealth-marketing and custody-system-provider rules; XRP likely is non-specified due no single issuance authority, but classification is inference and implementing rules are pending. Current prior research head 3700b322 passed 372-shard validator, 20 tests and fail-closed gate with merging disabled; default approval workflow still fails zero jobs on push because PR #1402 remains unmerged. No market feature admitted and no forecast issued.
